title: Per-VM netns TAP and nftables NAT

design_notes.determinism: NetConfig validation, AddressAllocator slot arithmetic, and nft_ruleset generation are pure (no I/O). NetManager filesystem ops take configurable root for unprivileged tests.
design_notes.nft_model: inet table microvm_nat with postrouting (masquerade) and forward (default-drop, explicit accept) chains. NatOnly restricts masquerade to host subnet; EgressAllowed masquerades to all.
design_notes.error_contract: NetworkSetupError for allocation/namespace failures; InvalidResourceSpec for config validation failures
